flavor: A single, monolithic slab of polished obsidian stands in the center of a perfectly circular chamber. No light source is visible, yet the air hums with a rhythmic, low-frequency vibration that resonates in the marrow of your bones.
name: The Altar of the Unseen Pulse
reason: The party must offer a memory or a drop of blood to the obsidian slab to unlock the heavy stone door on the far side.
